```c
		hc_make_read(&c, 2, 1, 12345, 64);
		right &= hc_refusal(c.upiu, c.dw0, 1u << 0, false) != NULL;
		hc_make_tur(&c, 0, 0);
		right &= hc_refusal(c.upiu, c.dw0, 1u << 0, false) == NULL;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: whitelist tried on %u commands made up and never sent -- READ(10/16), TEST UNIT READY, READ "
	    "CAPACITY of LUN 0 pass; WRITE(10/16), UNMAP, a READ with data host to device, a READ with the W flag, the "
	    "RPMB/BOOT/device/REPORT LUNS units, LUN 3, FORMAT, START STOP, SYNCHRONIZE CACHE, WRITE BUFFER, SECURITY "
	    "PROTOCOL, MODE SELECT, query, task management, NOP refused: %s\n",
	    (unsigned)(sizeof(cases) / sizeof(cases[0])) + 3, right ? "as it should" : "WRONG");
	return right;
}

/* ---- one command in one slot ---- */

static void
hc_put(volatile uint32_t *to, const void *from, uint32_t bytes)
{
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bytes / 4; i++) {
		uint32_t w;

		memcpy(&w, (const uint8_t *)from + 4 * i, 4);
		to[i] = w;
	}
}

/*
 * Into the slot: the command UPIU, an empty response, the PRD table for bytes of the slot's
 * buffer, the descriptor -- only a command the whitelist passes, and only if what the slot then
 * holds is the same and passes again.
 */
static int
hc_place(struct hc_slot *s, const struct hc_cmd *c, uint32_t bytes)
{
	uint32_t n = 0, back[8];

	if (!ufshc_permitted(c->upiu, c->dw0)) {
		return EPERM;
	}
	hc_put(s->ucd, c->upiu, sizeof(c->upiu));
	for (uint32_t i = sizeof(c->upiu) / 4; i < UCD_PRDT / 4; i++) {
		s->ucd[i] = 0;
	}
	for (uint32_t at = 0; at < bytes; at += PRD_MAX, n++) {
		volatile uint32_t *prd = s->ucd + (UCD_PRDT + 16 * n) / 4;
		uint64_t pa = s->data_pa + at;
		uint32_t len = bytes - at < PRD_MAX ? bytes - at : PRD_MAX;

		prd[0] = (uint32_t)pa;
		prd[1] = (uint32_t)(pa >> 32);
		prd[2] = 0;
		prd[3] = len - 1;
	}
	s->utrd[0] = c->dw0;
	s->utrd[1] = 0;
	s->utrd[2] = OCS_INVALID;
	s->utrd[3] = 0;
	s->utrd[4] = (uint32_t)s->ucd_pa;
	s->utrd[5] = (uint32_t)(s->ucd_pa >> 32);
	s->utrd[6] = ((UCD_RESPONSE / 4) << 16) | (UCD_RESPONSE / 4);   /* response: offset, length in dwords */
	s->utrd[7] = ((UCD_PRDT / 4) << 16) | n;                        /* PRD table: offset in dwords, entries */
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
		back[i] = s->ucd[i];
	}
	if (memcmp(back, c->upiu, sizeof(back)) != 0 || s->utrd[0] != c->dw0 ||
	    !ufshc_permitted((const uint8_t *)back, s->utrd[0])) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u does not hold what was put in it: not rung\n", s->number);
		hc_refused++;
		return EPERM;
	}
	return 0;
}

/* The doorbell: only while this kernel's list is the one in, running, and the loader not taking it back */
static int
hc_ring(struct hc_slot *s)
{
	uint32_t bit = 1u << s->number;
	boolean_t istate;
	bool ok;

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	ok = hc_in && !hc_closed && !hc_dead && *hc_loader.take_back == 0 &&
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_list_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_list_hi &&
	    (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) != 0 && (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) == 0;
	if (ok) {
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLDBR, bit);
	}
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	return ok ? 0 : ENXIO;
}

/*
 * ufs_native_hang=N (a test of the loader's side): once N reads are done, the thread that has just
 * rung a doorbell stops the kernel -- every processor spinning with interrupts off, this one
 * included -- with reads in flight and this kernel's list in. The heartbeat stops, and the
 * loader (or the watchdog) must take it from there.
 */
extern unsigned int cpu_broadcast_xcall(uint32_t *synch, boolean_t self_xcall, void (*func)(void *), void *parm);
static uint32_t hc_hang_after;
static volatile uint32_t hc_hanging;

static void
hc_spin_forever(__unused void *parm)
{
	(void)ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	for (;;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
}

static void
hc_hang(uint32_t slot)
{
	static int parm;

	/* (into the loader's log directly as well: a hung kernel's own log never comes back to it) */
	hc_say_late("ufs: native: ufs_native_hang=%u: the kernel stops HERE, every processor spinning with interrupts "
	    "off; slot %u just rung, doorbell %08x, %u reads in flight, this kernel's list in\n", hc_hang_after, slot,
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR), hc_in_flight);
	cpu_broadcast_xcall(NULL, TRUE, hc_spin_forever, &parm);
}

/* Nothing more is sent from here on; whoever waits for a slot is told. */
static void
hc_off(void)
{
	hc_dead = true;
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
}

/*
 * Waiting for the controller. Its interrupt stays off (UEFI's setting), so completions are seen
 * by reading UTRLDBR. A waiter looks at its own bit for a short while (hc_spin_us: a small read
 * is done by then), then sleeps; one poller thread looks for all who sleep and wakes each whose
 * slot is done. So the processors are not all taken by threads spinning on the doorbell, which
 * kept others -- one woken because the volume's lock came free, say -- from running.
 */
static volatile uint32_t hc_waiting;            /* slots whose waiters sleep (hc_lock) */
static uint32_t hc_done;                        /* slots the poller has seen done, not yet collected (hc_lock) */
static bool hc_poller_asleep;
static uint32_t hc_spin_us = 40;                /* boot-arg ufs_native_spin */
static uint64_t hc_sleeps, hc_poller_polls, hc_poller_rounds;

static void
hc_poller(__unused void *arg, __unused wait_result_t wr)
{
	for (;;) {
		uint32_t waiting, db, done;

		lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
		while (hc_waiting == 0) {
			hc_poller_asleep = true;
			msleep((void *)&hc_waiting, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc-poll", NULL);
		}
		hc_poller_asleep = false;
		waiting = hc_waiting;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		hc_poller_rounds++;
		/* until one of them is done, or another waiter comes */
		while (((db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) & waiting) == waiting && hc_waiting == waiting) {
			hc_poller_polls++;
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
		done = waiting & ~db;
		if (done != 0) {
			lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
			hc_done |= done;
			hc_waiting &= ~done;
			for (uint32_t m = done; m != 0; m &= m - 1) {
				wakeup(&hc_slots[__builtin_ctz(m)]);
			}
			lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		}
	}
}

/* Until the controller is done with the slot's command; then whether it went well. */
static int
hc_complete(struct hc_slot *s, const char *what, bool tur)
{
	uint64_t started = mach_absolute_time(), us;
	volatile const uint8_t *r = (volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd + UCD_RESPONSE;
	uint32_t ocs, bit = 1u << s->number;

	uint64_t polls = 1;

	while ((hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) && hc_us_since(started) < hc_spin_us) {
		polls++;
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	if (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) & bit) {
		struct timespec second = { 1, 0 };

		lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
		hc_sleeps++;
		hc_waiting |= bit;
		if (hc_poller_asleep) {
			wakeup((void *)&hc_waiting);
		}
		while ((hc_done & bit) == 0) {
			(void)msleep(s, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc-io", &second);
			us = hc_us_since(started);
			if ((hc_done & bit) == 0 && us > TIMEOUT_MS * 1000ULL) {
				hc_waiting &= ~bit;
				lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
				hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u (%s) not done in %u s (doorbell %08x, IS %08x, HCS %08x): "
				    "this path is off from now on\n", s->number, what, TIMEOUT_MS / 1000, hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR),
				    hc_read(UFSHC_IS), hc_read(UFSHC_HCS));
				hc_off();
				return ETIMEDOUT;
			}
		}
		hc_done &= ~bit;
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	}
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	os_atomic_add(&hc_polls, polls, relaxed);
	if (!tur) {
		os_atomic_add(&hc_wait_us, hc_us_since(started), relaxed);
	}
	ocs = s->utrd[2] & 0xff;
	if (ocs != OCS_SUCCESS || (r[0] & 0x3f) != UPIU_RESPONSE || r[3] != s->number || r[6] != 0 ||
	    (r[7] != 0 && !(tur && r[7] == 0x02))) {
		/* sense data follows the 32 bytes of the header: its length (2), then the fixed format */
		hc_say("ufs: native: slot %u (%s): OCS %x, response %02x tag %02x, response %02x status %02x, "
		    "sense key %x asc %02x ascq %02x\n", s->number, what, ocs, r[0], r[3], r[6], r[7],
		    r[34 + 2] & 0x0f, r[34 + 12], r[34 + 13]);
		if (!tur) {
			os_atomic_inc(&hc_errors, relaxed);
		}
		return EIO;
	}
	return 0;
}

static struct hc_slot *
hc_take(bool wait)
{
	struct hc_slot *s = NULL;
	uint64_t t0 = mach_absolute_time();

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	hc_lock_ticks += mach_absolute_time() - t0;
	if (hc_free == 0 && wait && !hc_dead && hc_in) {
		uint64_t w0 = mach_absolute_time();

		hc_slot_waits++;
		while (hc_free == 0 && wait && !hc_dead && hc_in) {
			msleep(&hc_free, &hc_lock, PRIBIO, "ufshc", NULL);
		}
		hc_slot_wait_ticks += mach_absolute_time() - w0;
	}
	if (hc_free != 0 && hc_in && !hc_dead) {
		uint32_t i = (uint32_t)__builtin_ctz(hc_free), f;

		hc_free &= ~(1u << i);
		s = &hc_slots[i];
		f = ++hc_in_flight;
		if (f > hc_most_in_flight) {
			hc_most_in_flight = f;
		}
		hc_flight_hist[f <= 1 ? 0 : f <= 2 ? 1 : f <= 4 ? 2 : f <= 8 ? 3 : f <= 16 ? 4 : 5]++;
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	return s;
}

static void
hc_give(struct hc_slot *s)
{
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	hc_free |= 1u << (s - hc_slots);
	hc_in_flight--;
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
}

/*
 * Bytes [offset, offset + len) of logical unit lun into dst: the blocks that cover them, a slot's
 * buffer at a time, with as many slots in flight at once as are free (at least one), the wanted
 * bytes copied out of each as it is done.
 */
int
ufshc_read(uint8_t lun, uint64_t offset, uint8_t *dst, uint64_t len)
{
	struct {
		struct hc_slot *slot;
		uint32_t lba, blocks, skip, take;
		uint8_t *to;
	} q[SLOTS];
	uint32_t head = 0, tail = 0, per = hc_slot_buffer / BLOCK;
	int error = 0;

	if (!hc_usable || !hc_in || hc_dead || hc_closed) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	while ((len > 0 && error == 0) || head != tail) {
		/* as many more reads as there are free slots (and one, waiting for it, if none is in flight) */
		while (len > 0 && error == 0 && tail - head < SLOTS) {
			uint64_t first = offset / BLOCK, skip = offset % BLOCK;
			uint64_t blocks = (skip + len + BLOCK - 1) / BLOCK, take;
			struct hc_slot *s = hc_take(head == tail);
			struct hc_cmd c;
			int e;

			if (s == NULL) {
				if (head == tail) {
					error = ENXIO;                  /* the path went off while waiting */
				}
				break;
			}
			if (blocks > per) {
				blocks = per;
			}
			if (first + blocks > 0xffffffffULL) {
				hc_give(s);
				error = EINVAL;
				break;
			}
			take = blocks * BLOCK - skip;
			if (take > len) {
				take = len;
			}
			hc_make_read(&c, lun, (uint8_t)s->number, (uint32_t)first, (uint32_t)blocks);
			/* nothing of the buffer is left in a cache to be written back over what the controller writes */
			FlushPoC_DcacheRegion((vm_offset_t)s->data, (size_t)blocks * BLOCK);
			e = hc_place(s, &c, (uint32_t)blocks * BLOCK);
			if (e == 0) {
				e = hc_ring(s);
			}
			if (e == 0 && hc_hang_after != 0 && hc_requests >= hc_hang_after &&
			    os_atomic_cmpxchg(&hc_hanging, 0, 1, relaxed)) {
				hc_hang(s->number);
			}
			if (e != 0) {
				hc_give(s);
				error = e;
				break;
			}
			q[tail % SLOTS].slot = s;
			q[tail % SLOTS].lba = (uint32_t)first;
			q[tail % SLOTS].blocks = (uint32_t)blocks;
			q[tail % SLOTS].skip = (uint32_t)skip;
			q[tail % SLOTS].take = (uint32_t)take;
			q[tail % SLOTS].to = dst;
			tail++;
			offset += take;
			dst += take;
			len -= take;
		}
		/* the oldest one done, copied out, its slot free again */
		if (head != tail) {
			typeof(q[0]) *e = &q[head % SLOTS];
			char what[48];
			int r;

			snprintf(what, sizeof(what), "LUN %u, blocks %u..%u", lun, e->lba, e->lba + e->blocks - 1);
			r = hc_complete(e->slot, what, false);
			if (r == 0) {
				FlushPoC_DcacheRegion((vm_offset_t)e->slot->data, (size_t)e->blocks * BLOCK);
				os_atomic_inc(&hc_requests, relaxed);
				os_atomic_add(&hc_bytes, (uint64_t)e->blocks * BLOCK, relaxed);
				if (error == 0) {
					memcpy(e->to, e->slot->data + e->skip, e->take);
				}
			} else if (error == 0) {
				error = r;
			}
			if (r != ETIMEDOUT) {
				hc_give(e->slot);                       /* (a slot that never came back is not used again) */
			}
			head++;
		}
	}
	return error;
}

/* ---- the proof, and the switches ---- */

/* UEFI's slot 0 holds a read (what the controller would run were it to take no notice of this list) */
static const char *
hc_uefi_slot0(uint8_t *upiu, uint32_t *dw0)
{
	uint64_t ucd = (uint64_t)hc_uefi_list[5] << 32 | hc_uefi_list[4];
	volatile const uint8_t *u;

	*dw0 = hc_uefi_list[0];
	if (ucd < hc_uefi_map_pa || ucd + 32 > hc_uefi_map_pa + hc_uefi_map_size) {
		return "UEFI's command descriptor is not where it was";
	}
	u = (volatile const uint8_t *)(hc_uefi_map_va + (ucd - hc_uefi_map_pa));
	for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
		upiu[i] = u[i];
	}
	return hc_refusal(upiu, *dw0, 0xff, true) == NULL ? NULL : "UEFI's slot 0 does not hold a read";
}

/* This kernel's slot 0: TEST UNIT READY rung, and its status must come back in this list */
static int
hc_prove(void)
{
	struct hc_slot *s = &hc_slots[SLOT_PROOF];
	struct hc_cmd c;
	uint32_t ocs;
	int e;

	hc_make_tur(&c, (uint8_t)__builtin_ctz(hc_lun_mask), SLOT_PROOF);
	e = hc_place(s, &c, 0);
	if (e == 0) {
		e = hc_ring(s);
	}
	if (e == 0) {
		e = hc_complete(s, "the proof's TEST UNIT READY", true);
	}
	ocs = s->utrd[2] & 0xff;
	hc_proofs++;
	if (e != 0 || ocs != OCS_SUCCESS) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: proof FAILED (%d): this list's slot 0 has OCS %x after its doorbell -- the controller "
		    "did not run it from this list\n", e, ocs);
		return e != 0 ? e : EIO;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: proof: TEST UNIT READY in this list's slot 0 came back here (OCS 0, response %02x, status %02x)\n",
	    ((volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd)[UCD_RESPONSE + 6], ((volatile const uint8_t *)s->ucd)[UCD_RESPONSE + 7]);
	return 0;
}

struct hc_put_back_result {
	uint32_t db_before, db_after_clear, lo, hi, rsr, db, is, cnr, cnr_ours;
	bool cleared, ok;
};

/*
 * UEFI's list back into the controller: what is in flight waited for (1 s), cleared if it does
 * not finish (every slot of this list is this kernel's), the list stopped, UEFI's address
 * written, the list started, read back. Interrupts off, no locks, no printing (the quiesce).
 */
static void
hc_put_back(struct hc_put_back_result *r)
{
	uint64_t t;

	bzero(r, sizeof(*r));
	for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (r->db_before = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) != 0 && hc_us_since(t) < 1000000;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	if (r->db_before != 0 && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_list_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_list_hi) {
		r->cleared = true;
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLCLR, 0);
		for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (r->db_after_clear = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR)) != 0 && hc_us_since(t) < 1000000;) {
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
	}
	/* the completion notifications this kernel's requests left: exactly those bits, written with ones */
	r->cnr_ours = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR) & ~hc_cnr_in;
	if (r->cnr_ours != 0) {
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLCNR, r->cnr_ours);
	}
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 0);
	for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) && hc_us_since(t) < 5000;) {
		__builtin_arm_yield();
	}
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBA, hc_loader.uefi_lo);
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBAU, hc_loader.uefi_hi);
	hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);
	r->lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	r->hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	r->rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	r->db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	r->is = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
	r->cnr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
	r->ok = r->lo == hc_loader.uefi_lo && r->hi == hc_loader.uefi_hi && (r->rsr & 1);
	if (r->ok) {
		*hc_loader.list_in = 0;
		(*hc_loader.switched_out)++;
		hc_switch_out_count++;
	}
}

static void
hc_put_back_print(const char *why, const struct hc_put_back_result *r, bool late)
{
	void (*say)(const char *, ...) = late ? hc_say_late : hc_say;

	if (r->cleared) {
		say("ufs: native: %s: doorbell %08x did not clear in 1 s: this kernel's slots cleared (UTRLCLR), doorbell "
		    "then %08x\n", why, r->db_before, r->db_after_clear);
	}
	say("ufs: native: %s: transfer list %s UEFI's %08x:%08x (run %u, doorbell %08x; IS %08x, at the switch %08x; "
	    "completion %08x after clearing this kernel's %08x, at the switch %08x%s)\n", why, r->ok ? "back to" :
	    "NOT BACK TO", r->hi, r->lo, r->rsr, r->db, r->is, hc_is_in, r->cnr, r->cnr_ours, hc_cnr_in,
	    r->cnr == hc_cnr_in ? ", as it was" : ", NOT AS IT WAS");
}

/*
 * This kernel's list into the controller (the caller holds the loader's mailbox: nothing is asked
 * of UEFI meanwhile). prove: then slot 0's TEST UNIT READY, before anything is read.
 */
int
ufshc_switch_in(bool prove)
{
	uint32_t lo, hi, db, rsr, hcs, uefi_dw0 = 0;
	uint8_t uefi_upiu[32] = { 0 };
	const char *no = NULL;
	struct hc_put_back_result undo;
	boolean_t istate;
	bool undone = false;

	if (!hc_usable || hc_dead || hc_closed) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	if (hc_in) {
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		return 0;
	}
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	if (*hc_loader.take_back != 0) {
		no = "the loader has taken the controller back";
	} else {
		no = hc_uefi_slot0(uefi_upiu, &uefi_dw0);
	}
	lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	hcs = hc_read(UFSHC_HCS);
	if (no == NULL) {
		if (lo != hc_loader.uefi_lo || hi != hc_loader.uefi_hi) {
			no = "the controller's list is not UEFI's";
		} else if (db != 0) {
			no = "a request in flight";
		} else if ((rsr & 1) == 0 || (hcs & HCS_UTRLRDY) == 0) {
			no = "the list is not running, or not ready";
		}
	}
	if (no == NULL) {
		uint64_t t;

		hc_is_in = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
		hc_cnr_in = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
		hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 0);
		for (t = mach_absolute_time(); (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) && hc_us_since(t) < 5000;) {
			__builtin_arm_yield();
		}
		if (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1) {
			no = "the list did not stop";
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);     /* (UEFI's list, running, as it was) */
		} else {
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBA, hc_list_lo);
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLBAU, hc_list_hi);
			hc_write(UFSHC_UTRLRSR, 1);
			lo = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
			hi = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
			rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
			if (lo != hc_list_lo || hi != hc_list_hi || (rsr & 1) == 0) {
				no = "the controller did not take this list";
				hc_put_back(&undo);
				undone = true;
			} else {
				hc_in = true;
				*hc_loader.cnr_at_switch = hc_cnr_in;
				*hc_loader.list_in = 1;
				(*hc_loader.switched_in)++;
				hc_switch_in_count++;
			}
		}
	}
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	if (undone) {
		hc_put_back_print("undoing", &undo, false);
	}
	if (no != NULL) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: this kernel's list not put in: %s (list %08x:%08x, doorbell %08x, run %08x, HCS %08x; UEFI's "
		    "slot 0 %08x, CDB %02x)\n", no, hi, lo, db, rsr, hcs, uefi_dw0, uefi_upiu[16]);
		return EIO;
	}
	hc_say("ufs: native: transfer list switched from UEFI's %08x:%08x to this kernel's %08x:%08x (doorbell 0, run %u; "
	    "IS %08x, completion %08x; UEFI's slot 0 holds a read: %08x, CDB %02x)\n", hc_loader.uefi_hi,
	    hc_loader.uefi_lo, hi, lo, rsr, hc_is_in, hc_cnr_in, uefi_dw0, uefi_upiu[16]);
	if (prove) {
		int e = hc_prove();

		if (e != 0) {
			ufshc_switch_out("after the failed proof");
			hc_off();
			return e;
		}
	}
	return 0;
}

/* UEFI's list back (the caller holds the loader's mailbox) */
int
ufshc_switch_out(const char *why)
{
	struct hc_put_back_result r;
	uint64_t started;
	boolean_t istate;

	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	if (!hc_in) {
		lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
		return 0;
	}
	hc_in = false;                          /* nothing more is rung */
	wakeup(&hc_free);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	/* what is in flight finishes (whoever waits for it sees it done) */
	for (started = mach_absolute_time(); hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR) != 0 && hc_us_since(started) < 2000000;) {
		IOSleep(1);
	}
	lck_mtx_lock(&hc_lock);
	istate = ml_set_interrupts_enabled(FALSE);
	hc_put_back(&r);
	ml_set_interrupts_enabled(istate);
	lck_mtx_unlock(&hc_lock);
	hc_put_back_print(why, &r, false);
	if (!r.ok) {
		hc_off();
		return EIO;
	}
	return 0;
}

bool
ufshc_list_in(void)
{
	return hc_in;
}

bool
ufshc_available(void)
{
	return hc_usable && !hc_dead && !hc_closed;
}

void
ufshc_set_luns(uint32_t mask)
{
	hc_lun_mask = mask & 0xff;
}

static void
hc_report(const char *when, bool late)
{
	(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: %llu reads, %llu errors, %llu bytes, %llu ms waiting (summed over reads), at most %llu "
	    "in flight, %llu refused, list in %llu times and out %llu times, %llu proofs%s\n", when, hc_requests, hc_errors,
	    hc_bytes, hc_wait_us / 1000, hc_most_in_flight, hc_refused, hc_switch_in_count, hc_switch_out_count, hc_proofs,
	    hc_dead ? "; THE PATH IS OFF" : "");
	{
		uint64_t wait_ns, lock_ns;

		absolutetime_to_nanoseconds(hc_slot_wait_ticks, &wait_ns);
		absolutetime_to_nanoseconds(hc_lock_ticks, &lock_ns);
		(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: %llu doorbell reads while waiting (%llu a read), %llu waits for a "
		    "free slot (%llu ms), %llu ms taking the slots' lock; reads put in with 1 in flight %llu, 2 %llu, 3-4 %llu, "
		    "5-8 %llu, 9-16 %llu, more %llu\n", when, hc_polls, hc_requests ? hc_polls / hc_requests : 0, hc_slot_waits,
		    wait_ns / 1000000, lock_ns / 1000000, hc_flight_hist[0], hc_flight_hist[1], hc_flight_hist[2],
		    hc_flight_hist[3], hc_flight_hist[4], hc_flight_hist[5]);
		(late ? hc_say_late : hc_say)("ufs: native: %s: waiters spin %u us, then sleep: %llu slept; the poller %llu "
		    "rounds, %llu doorbell reads\n", when, hc_spin_us, hc_sleeps, hc_poller_rounds, hc_poller_polls);
	}
}

void
ufshc_report(const char *when)
{
	if (hc_usable) {
		hc_report(when, false);
	}
}

/* ---- the probe ---- */

/*
 * What the controller looks like as UEFI left it, and whether this kernel may put a list of its
 * own in (only == true: say so and do not use it).
 */
bool
ufshc_probe(const struct ufshc_loader *loader, bool only)
{
	uint32_t cap, ver, hcs, hce, is, ie, iacr, ahit, base, baseu, db, rsr, cnr, tm_base, tm_baseu, tm_db, tm_rsr;
	uint32_t uefi_dw0 = 0, slots = 31;
	uint8_t uefi_upiu[32] = { 0 };
	uint64_t uefi_pa;
	const char *no = NULL;
	vm_offset_t area;

	if (!hc_whitelist_selftest()) {
		return false;
	}
	hc_loader = *loader;
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_buffer", &hc_slot_buffer, sizeof(hc_slot_buffer));
	if (hc_slot_buffer < BLOCK || hc_slot_buffer > (4u << 20) || hc_slot_buffer % BLOCK) {
		hc_slot_buffer = SLOT_BUFFER_DEFAULT;
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_slots", &slots, sizeof(slots));
	if (slots < 1 || slots > SLOTS - 1) {
		slots = SLOTS - 1;
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_leave", &hc_leave, sizeof(hc_leave));
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_hang", &hc_hang_after, sizeof(hc_hang_after));
	if (loader->hc_pa != UFSHC_PHYS || loader->area_pa == 0 || loader->slots != SLOTS || (loader->area_pa & 0x3ff) ||
	    loader->ucd_size < UCD_PRDT + 16 * (hc_slot_buffer / PRD_MAX + 1) || (loader->ucd_offset & 0x7f) ||
	    (loader->ucd_size & 0x7f) || loader->ucd_offset < SLOTS * 32 ||
	    loader->area_size < loader->ucd_offset + SLOTS * loader->ucd_size) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: the loader offers no area for a list (or not one as expected: controller %llx, "
		    "area %llx of %u, command descriptors at %u of %u)\n", loader->hc_pa, loader->area_pa, loader->area_size,
		    loader->ucd_offset, loader->ucd_size);
		return false;
	}
	if (pmap_valid_address(loader->area_pa) || pmap_valid_address(loader->area_pa + loader->area_size - 1)) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: the loader's area %llx is memory this kernel manages\n", loader->area_pa);
		return false;
	}
	hc = ml_io_map(UFSHC_PHYS, UFSHC_SIZE);
	cap = hc_read(UFSHC_CAP);
	ver = hc_read(UFSHC_VER);
	hcs = hc_read(UFSHC_HCS);
	hce = hc_read(UFSHC_HCE);
	is = hc_read(UFSHC_IS);
	ie = hc_read(UFSHC_IE);
	iacr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRIACR);
	ahit = hc_read(UFSHC_AHIT);
	base = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA);
	baseu = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU);
	db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR);
	rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR);
	cnr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLCNR);
	tm_base = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLBA);
	tm_baseu = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLBAU);
	tm_db = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLDBR);
	tm_rsr = hc_read(UFSHC_UTMRLRSR);
	hc_say("ufs: native: controller at %llx: CAP %08x (%u slots, 64-bit %s), VER %08x, HCDDID %08x, HCPMID %08x\n",
	    UFSHC_PHYS, cap, CAP_NUTRS(cap), (cap & CAP_64AS) ? "yes" : "no", ver, hc_read(UFSHC_HCDDID),
	    hc_read(UFSHC_HCPMID));
	hc_say("ufs: native: HCE %08x, HCS %08x, IS %08x, IE %08x, UTRIACR %08x, AHIT %08x\n", hce, hcs, is, ie, iacr, ahit);
	hc_say("ufs: native: transfer list %08x:%08x (the loader's note of UEFI's: %08x:%08x), doorbell %08x, run %08x, "
	    "completion %08x; task management list %08x:%08x, doorbell %08x, run %08x\n", baseu, base, loader->uefi_hi,
	    loader->uefi_lo, db, rsr, cnr, tm_baseu, tm_base, tm_db, tm_rsr);
	uefi_pa = (uint64_t)baseu << 32 | base;

	if ((hce & 1) == 0) {
		no = "the controller is not enabled";
	} else if ((hcs & (HCS_DP | HCS_UTRLRDY)) != (HCS_DP | HCS_UTRLRDY)) {
		no = "no device present or the transfer list not ready";
	} else if ((rsr & 1) == 0) {
		no = "the transfer list is not running";
	} else if (ver < 0x200 || ver >= 0x400) {
		no = "a controller version other than 2.x or 3.x";
	} else if (CAP_NUTRS(cap) < SLOTS) {
		no = "fewer than 32 slots";
	} else if ((cap & CAP_64AS) == 0) {
		no = "no 64-bit addressing";
	} else if (is & IS_FATAL) {
		no = "an error status";
	} else if (base != loader->uefi_lo || baseu != loader->uefi_hi) {
		no = "the transfer list is not the one the loader noted as UEFI's";
	} else if (db != 0) {
		no = "a request in flight";
	} else if (pmap_valid_address(uefi_pa)) {
		no = "UEFI's transfer list is in memory this kernel manages";
	}
	if (no == NULL) {
		/* UEFI's list and command descriptor (the page they are in), not cached here, only read */
		hc_uefi_map_pa = uefi_pa & ~(uint64_t)PAGE_MASK;
		hc_uefi_map_size = PAGE_SIZE;
		hc_uefi_map_va = ml_io_map_unmappable((vm_offset_t)hc_uefi_map_pa, PAGE_SIZE, VM_WIMG_WCOMB);
		hc_uefi_list = (volatile uint32_t *)(hc_uefi_map_va + (uefi_pa - hc_uefi_map_pa));
		hc_say("ufs: native: UEFI's slot 0: %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x %08x\n", hc_uefi_list[0], hc_uefi_list[1],
		    hc_uefi_list[2], hc_uefi_list[3], hc_uefi_list[4], hc_uefi_list[5], hc_uefi_list[6], hc_uefi_list[7]);
		no = hc_uefi_slot0(uefi_upiu, &uefi_dw0);
		hc_say("ufs: native: UEFI's last command: UPIU %02x %02x %02x %02x, CDB %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x %02x "
		    "%02x %02x\n", uefi_upiu[0], uefi_upiu[1], uefi_upiu[2], uefi_upiu[3], uefi_upiu[16], uefi_upiu[17],
		    uefi_upiu[18], uefi_upiu[19], uefi_upiu[20], uefi_upiu[21], uefi_upiu[22], uefi_upiu[23], uefi_upiu[24],
		    uefi_upiu[25]);
	}
	if (no != NULL) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: not used: %s; the storage is read through the loader\n", no);
		return false;
	}
	if (only) {
		hc_say("ufs: native: as expected; ufs_native=2 asks for no more than this look\n");
		return false;
	}

	/* this kernel's list and command descriptors, in the loader's area; every slot TEST UNIT READY to begin with */
	area = ml_io_map_unmappable((vm_offset_t)(loader->area_pa & ~(uint64_t)PAGE_MASK),
	    (vm_size_t)round_page((loader->area_pa & PAGE_MASK) + loader->area_size), VM_WIMG_WCOMB) +
	    (vm_offset_t)(loader->area_pa & PAGE_MASK);
	hc_list_lo = (uint32_t)loader->area_pa;
	hc_list_hi = (uint32_t)(loader->area_pa >> 32);
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < SLOTS; i++) {
		struct hc_slot *s = &hc_slots[i];
		struct hc_cmd c;

		s->number = i;
		s->utrd = (volatile uint32_t *)(area + 32 * i);
		s->ucd = (volatile uint32_t *)(area + loader->ucd_offset + i * loader->ucd_size);
		s->ucd_pa = loader->area_pa + loader->ucd_offset + i * loader->ucd_size;
		if (i >= 1 && i <= slots) {
			vm_offset_t data = 0;

			if (kmem_alloc_contig(kernel_map, &data, round_page(hc_slot_buffer), PAGE_MASK, 0, 0,
			    KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
				hc_say("ufs: native: not used: no memory for the slots' buffers\n");
				return false;
			}
			s->data = (uint8_t *)data;
			s->data_pa = kvtophys(data);
			FlushPoC_DcacheRegion(data, hc_slot_buffer);
		}
		hc_make_tur(&c, 0, (uint8_t)i);
		if (hc_place(s, &c, 0) != 0) {
			hc_say("ufs: native: not used: slot %u would not take its TEST UNIT READY\n", i);
			return false;
		}
	}
	PE_parse_boot_argn("ufs_native_spin", &hc_spin_us, sizeof(hc_spin_us));
	if (hc_spin_us > 5000) {
		hc_spin_us = 5000;
	}
	{
		thread_t th;

		if (kernel_thread_start(hc_poller, NULL, &th) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
			hc_say("ufs: native: not used: no poller thread\n");
			return false;
		}
		thread_deallocate(th);
	}
	hc_nslots = slots;
	hc_free = (uint32_t)(((1ULL << (slots + 1)) - 1) & ~1ULL);       /* slots 1..n */
	hc_usable = true;
	hc_say("ufs: native: usable: a list of %u slots at %llx (the loader's), reads in %u of them, %u KB each (the logical units reads may go to are set by redwood_ufs.c)%s\n",
	    SLOTS, loader->area_pa, slots, hc_slot_buffer >> 10, hc_leave ? "; ufs_native_leave=1: the list is left in "
	    "at the end, for the loader to take back" : "");
	return true;
}

/*
 * Before the kernel gives the phone back to the loader (loader_return, the other processors
 * already stopped): nothing more is sent, what is in flight is waited for, UEFI's list put back.
 * No locks (a stopped processor may hold one).
 */
void
redwood_ufs_quiesce(void)
{
	struct hc_put_back_result r;

	if (hc_kept_count != 0) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: what happened in this run, again:\n");
		for (uint32_t i = hc_kept_count > KEPT_LINES ? hc_kept_count - KEPT_LINES : 0; i < hc_kept_count; i++) {
			const char *line = hc_kept[i % KEPT_LINES];

			hc_say_late("> %s%s", line, line[0] != 0 && line[strlen(line) - 1] == '\n' ? "" : "...\n");
		}
	}
	if (!hc_usable) {
		return;
	}
	hc_closed = true;
	__asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
	hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: entered with doorbell %08x, %u reads of this kernel's in flight, its list %s\n",
	    hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR), hc_in_flight, hc_in ? "in" : "out");
	if (!hc_in && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBA) == hc_loader.uefi_lo && hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLBAU) == hc_loader.uefi_hi &&
	    (hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLRSR) & 1)) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: UEFI's list is in (doorbell %08x)\n", hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR));
		hc_report("at the end", true);
		return;
	}
	hc_in = false;
	if (hc_leave) {
		hc_say_late("ufs: native: at the end: this kernel's list LEFT IN for the loader to take back "
		    "(ufs_native_leave=1; doorbell %08x)\n", hc_read(UFSHC_UTRLDBR));
		hc_report("at the end", true);
		return;
	}
	hc_put_back(&r);
	hc_put_back_print("at the end", &r, true);
	hc_report("at the end", true);
}

```

```h
#ifndef _REDWOOD_UFSHC_H_

/* what the loader's page says about it (struct loader_block's native sections) */
```

`xnu/files/bsd/dev/redwood_virtio_blk.c`:

```c
/*
 * A virtio block device, so that a disk image on the host can be a block device in the
 * guest (/dev/rvblk0).  Only with boot-arg virtio_blk=1: the bus address is QEMU's and
 * means nothing on the phone.
 *
 * This exists for the APFS driver.  The volume in ios165/rootfs.dmg is 5.6 GB, which is
 * too much to hold in guest memory as a RAM disk the way this port's own images are held, and the
 * point of reading APFS is to read a real image rather than one cut down to fit.  QEMU
 * serves it straight off the host's disk:
 *
 *   -drive file=rootfs.apfs,format=raw,if=none,id=d,readonly=on
 *   -device virtio-blk-device,drive=d
 *
 * Under QEMU's "virt" machine the transport is virtio-mmio and must be the current one,
 * not "legacy" (-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false).
 *
 * No interrupt is used and only one request is outstanding at a time: a request is put on
 * the queue, the device is notified, and the used ring is watched until it comes back.
 * That is slow in principle and entirely adequate here -- reads come from the APFS
 * driver's own block cache misses, and the host is serving them out of its page cache.
 *
 * Read only.  A write request is refused: nothing in this port has any business writing
 * to the image, and refusing is one less way to damage it by accident.
 */

#include <kern/clock.h>
#include <kern/locks.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <mach/mach_types.h>
#include <mach/vm_param.h>
#include <miscfs/devfs/devfs.h>
#include <pexpert/pexpert.h>
#include <sys/buf.h>
#include <sys/conf.h>
#include <sys/disk.h>
#include <sys/errno.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>
#include <sys/redwood_virtio_blk.h>
#include <vm/vm_kern.h>

extern vm_offset_t ml_io_map(vm_offset_t phys_addr, vm_size_t size);
extern uint64_t kvtophys(vm_offset_t va);

#define VIRTIO_BUS              0x0a000000UL    /* QEMU virt: 32 transports of 0x200 bytes */
#define VIRTIO_SLOTS            32
#define VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE        0x200

#define VIRTIO_MAGIC            0x000           /* "virt" */
#define VIRTIO_VERSION          0x004
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID        0x008
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES  0x020
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL 0x024
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL        0x030
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX    0x034
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM        0x038
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY      0x044
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY     0x050
#define VIRTIO_INTERRUPT_ACK    0x064
#define VIRTIO_STATUS           0x070
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC       0x080
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER     0x090
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE     0x0a0
#define VIRTIO_CONFIG           0x100           /* the device's own configuration */

#define VIRTIO_ID_BLOCK         2
#define STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE      1
#define STATUS_DRIVER           2
#define STATUS_DRIVER_OK        4
#define STATUS_FEATURES_OK      8

#define QUEUE_SIZE              64
#define DESC_F_NEXT             1
#define DESC_F_WRITE            2
#define AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT    1

/* the request types we use */
#define VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN         0
#define VIRTIO_BLK_S_OK         0

#define VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR       512             /* virtio-blk counts in these, always */

/*
 * The most one request may carry.  A request needs one descriptor for its header, one for
 * its status byte and one per page of the data, so this bounds the chain well inside the
 * queue.
 */
#define BLK_MAX_XFER            (64 * 1024)
#define BLK_MAX_DATA_DESC       (BLK_MAX_XFER / PAGE_SIZE + 1)

struct vq_desc {
	uint64_t addr;
	uint32_t len;
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t next;
};
struct vq_avail {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	uint16_t ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct vq_used {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	struct {
		uint32_t id;
		uint32_t len;
	} ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct blk_req_hdr {
	uint32_t type;
	uint32_t reserved;
	uint64_t sector;
};

/* the ring and the small request pieces share one page */
#define OFFSET_DESC             0x0000
#define OFFSET_AVAIL            0x0400
#define OFFSET_USED             0x0800
#define OFFSET_HDR              0x0c00
#define OFFSET_STATUS           0x0c40

struct blk_device {
	vm_offset_t          regs;
	vm_offset_t          page;
	uint64_t             page_phys;
	struct vq_desc      *desc;
	struct vq_avail     *avail;
	struct vq_used      *used;
	struct blk_req_hdr  *hdr;
	volatile uint8_t    *status;
	uint16_t             seen;      /* how far the used ring has been read */
	uint64_t             capacity;  /* in 512-byte sectors */
	lck_mtx_t            lock;
};

static LCK_GRP_DECLARE(blk_lck_grp, "redwood-virtio-blk");
static struct blk_device blk_dev;
static bool blk_ready;
static int blk_bmajor = -1, blk_cmajor = -1;

/* One of this driver's devices: every request is a trip through the hypervisor */
bool
redwood_virtio_blk_dev(dev_t dev)
{
	return (blk_bmajor >= 0 && major(dev) == blk_bmajor) ||
	       (blk_cmajor >= 0 && major(dev) == blk_cmajor);
}

static inline uint32_t
reg_read(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg);
}

static inline void
reg_write(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg) = value;
}

static inline void
reg_write64(struct blk_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint64_t value)
{
	reg_write(d, reg, (uint32_t)value);
	reg_write(d, reg + 4, (uint32_t)(value >> 32));
}

/*
 * One read.  `data` is kernel memory that need not be page aligned and whose pages need
 * not be next to each other in physical memory, so it goes on the queue a page at a time.
 */
static int
blk_read(struct blk_device *d, uint64_t offset, void *data, size_t len)
{
	vm_offset_t va = (vm_offset_t)data;
	uint16_t idx = 0;
	size_t done = 0;
	uint64_t deadline;
	int error = 0;

	if (len == 0 || len > BLK_MAX_XFER) {
		return EINVAL;
	}
	if ((offset % VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) != 0) {
		return EINVAL;
	}
	if (offset / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR >= d->capacity ||
	    (offset + len) / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR > d->capacity) {
		return EINVAL;
	}

	lck_mtx_lock(&d->lock);

	d->hdr->type = VIRTIO_BLK_T_IN;
	d->hdr->reserved = 0;
	d->hdr->sector = offset / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
	*d->status = 0xff;

	/* descriptor 0: the header, which the device reads */
	d->desc[0].addr = d->page_phys + OFFSET_HDR;
	d->desc[0].len = sizeof(struct blk_req_hdr);
	d->desc[0].flags = DESC_F_NEXT;
	d->desc[0].next = 1;
	idx = 1;

	/* then the data, one descriptor per run of bytes inside a page */
	while (done < len) {
		vm_offset_t at = va + done;
		size_t chunk = PAGE_SIZE - (at & PAGE_MASK);

		if (chunk > len - done) {
			chunk = len - done;
		}
		if (idx >= 1 + BLK_MAX_DATA_DESC) {
			lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
			return EINVAL;
		}
		d->desc[idx].addr = kvtophys(at);
		d->desc[idx].len = (uint32_t)chunk;
		d->desc[idx].flags = DESC_F_WRITE | DESC_F_NEXT;
		d->desc[idx].next = (uint16_t)(idx + 1);
		idx++;
		done += chunk;
	}

	/* last: the status byte, which the device writes */
	d->desc[idx].addr = d->page_phys + OFFSET_STATUS;
	d->desc[idx].len = 1;
	d->desc[idx].flags = DESC_F_WRITE;
	d->desc[idx].next = 0;

	d->avail->flags = AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT;
	d->avail->ring[d->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = 0;         /* the chain starts at 0 */
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	d->avail->idx++;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, 0);

	/* wait for it to come back; a read off the host's disk should take microseconds */
	clock_interval_to_deadline(10, NSEC_PER_SEC, &deadline);
	for (;;) {
		__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
		if (d->used->idx != d->seen) {
			d->seen = d->used->idx;
			break;
		}
		if (mach_absolute_time() > deadline) {
			printf("virtio-blk: a read of %lu bytes at %llu went unanswered\n",
			    (unsigned long)len, offset);
			lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
			return EIO;
		}
		delay(10);
	}
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_INTERRUPT_ACK, reg_read(d, 0x060));  /* keep the device quiet */

	if (*d->status != VIRTIO_BLK_S_OK) {
		printf("virtio-blk: a read of %lu bytes at %llu failed with status %u\n",
		    (unsigned long)len, offset, *d->status);
		error = EIO;
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&d->lock);
	return error;
}

/* ---- the block device ---- */

static int
blk_dev_open(__unused dev_t dev, int flags, __unused int devtype, __unused proc_t p)
{
	if (!blk_ready) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	if (flags & FWRITE) {
		return EROFS;
	}
	return 0;
}

static int
blk_dev_close(__unused dev_t dev, __unused int flags, __unused int devtype,
    __unused proc_t p)
{
	return 0;
}

static void
blk_dev_strategy(buf_t bp)
{
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;
	uint64_t offset;
	size_t len;
	int error;

	if (!blk_ready) {
		buf_seterror(bp, ENXIO);
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	if (!(buf_flags(bp) & B_READ)) {
		buf_seterror(bp, EROFS);         /* this device never writes */
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	offset = (uint64_t)buf_blkno(bp) * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
	len = buf_count(bp);

	/* trim a request that runs off the end, and refuse one that starts past it */
	if (offset >= d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
		buf_seterror(bp, offset == d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR ? 0 : EINVAL);
		buf_setresid(bp, buf_count(bp));
		buf_biodone(bp);
		return;
	}
	if (offset + len > d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
		len = (size_t)(d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR - offset);
	}

	error = 0;
	{
		uint8_t *dst = (uint8_t *)buf_dataptr(bp);
		size_t done = 0;

		while (done < len && error == 0) {
			size_t chunk = len - done;

			if (chunk > BLK_MAX_XFER) {
				chunk = BLK_MAX_XFER;
			}
			error = blk_read(d, offset + done, dst + done, chunk);
			done += chunk;
		}
		buf_setresid(bp, (uint32_t)(buf_count(bp) - (error ? 0 : done)));
	}
	if (error) {
		buf_seterror(bp, error);
	}
	buf_biodone(bp);
}

static int
blk_dev_ioctl(__unused dev_t dev, u_long cmd, caddr_t data, __unused int fflag,
    __unused proc_t p)
{
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;

	if (!blk_ready) {
		return ENXIO;
	}
	switch (cmd) {
	case DKIOCGETBLOCKSIZE:
		*(uint32_t *)data = VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCSETBLOCKSIZE:
		/*
		 * spec_open() sets the block size to 512 to count the device in 512-byte
		 * blocks and then sets it back, and treats a refusal of either as the device
		 * being broken (ENXIO).  virtio-blk counts in 512-byte sectors and nothing
		 * else, so that is the only size to agree to.
		 */
		if (*(uint32_t *)data != VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR) {
			return EINVAL;
		}
		return 0;
	case DKIOCGETBLOCKCOUNT:
		*(uint64_t *)data = d->capacity;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCISWRITABLE:
		*(uint32_t *)data = 0;
		return 0;
	case DKIOCGETMAXBLOCKCOUNTREAD:
		*(uint64_t *)data = BLK_MAX_XFER / VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR;
		return 0;
	default:
		return ENOTTY;
	}
}

static int
blk_dev_size(dev_t dev)
{
	(void)dev;
	return blk_ready ? VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR : -1;
}

static int
blk_dev_read(__unused dev_t dev, struct uio *uio, __unused int ioflag)
{
	/* the character device is here so that tools can see the disk; reads go by buffer */
	return physio(blk_dev_strategy, NULL, dev, B_READ, (u_int (*)(buf_t))blk_dev_size,
	    uio, VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR);
}

static const struct bdevsw blk_bdevsw = {
	.d_open     = blk_dev_open,
	.d_close    = blk_dev_close,
	.d_strategy = blk_dev_strategy,
	.d_ioctl    = blk_dev_ioctl,
	.d_dump     = eno_dump,
	.d_psize    = blk_dev_size,
	.d_type     = D_DISK,
};

static const struct cdevsw blk_cdevsw = {
	.d_open       = blk_dev_open,
	.d_close      = blk_dev_close,
	.d_read       = blk_dev_read,
	.d_write      = eno_rdwrt,
	.d_ioctl      = blk_dev_ioctl,
	.d_stop       = eno_stop,
	.d_reset      = eno_reset,
	.d_ttys       = NULL,
	.d_select     = eno_select,
	.d_mmap       = eno_mmap,
	.d_strategy   = eno_strat,
	.d_reserved_1 = eno_getc,
	.d_reserved_2 = eno_putc,
	.d_type       = D_DISK,
};

/* ---- bringing it up ---- */

static bool
blk_attach(struct blk_device *d, int slot)
{
	uint32_t cap_lo, cap_hi;

	if (kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &d->page, PAGE_SIZE,
	    KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	d->page_phys = kvtophys(d->page);
	d->desc = (struct vq_desc *)(d->page + OFFSET_DESC);
	d->avail = (struct vq_avail *)(d->page + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	d->used = (struct vq_used *)(d->page + OFFSET_USED);
	d->hdr = (struct blk_req_hdr *)(d->page + OFFSET_HDR);
	d->status = (volatile uint8_t *)(d->page + OFFSET_STATUS);

	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, 0);         /* reset */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER);
	/* nothing in the low half is wanted; bit 32 is VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK);
	if (!(reg_read(d, VIRTIO_STATUS) & STATUS_FEATURES_OK)) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: features refused\n", slot);
		return false;
	}

	cap_lo = reg_read(d, VIRTIO_CONFIG);
	cap_hi = reg_read(d, VIRTIO_CONFIG + 4);
	d->capacity = ((uint64_t)cap_hi << 32) | cap_lo;
	if (d->capacity == 0) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: the disk is empty\n", slot);
		return false;
	}

	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL, 0);
	if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX) < QUEUE_SIZE) {
		printf("virtio-blk: slot %d: request queue of %u\n", slot,
		    reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX));
		return false;
	}
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM, QUEUE_SIZE);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC, d->page_phys + OFFSET_DESC);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER, d->page_phys + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE, d->page_phys + OFFSET_USED);
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS,
	    STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK | STATUS_DRIVER_OK);
	return true;
}

void
redwood_virtio_blk_init(void)
{
	uint32_t enabled = 0;
	vm_offset_t bus;
	struct blk_device *d = &blk_dev;
	int slot;

	if (!PE_parse_boot_argn("virtio_blk", &enabled, sizeof(enabled)) || !enabled) {
		return;
	}
	bus = ml_io_map(VIRTIO_BUS, VIRTIO_SLOTS * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE);
	for (slot = 0; slot < VIRTIO_SLOTS; slot++) {
		d->regs = bus + (vm_offset_t)slot * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE;
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_MAGIC) != 0x74726976 ||
		    reg_read(d, VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID) != VIRTIO_ID_BLOCK) {
			continue;
		}
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_VERSION) != 2) {
			printf("virtio-blk: slot %d is a legacy transport; start QEMU with "
			    "-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false\n", slot);
			continue;
		}
		lck_mtx_init(&d->lock, &blk_lck_grp, LCK_ATTR_NULL);
		if (!blk_attach(d, slot)) {
			lck_mtx_destroy(&d->lock, &blk_lck_grp);
			continue;
		}
		blk_bmajor = bdevsw_add(-1, &blk_bdevsw);
		if (blk_bmajor < 0) {
			printf("virtio-blk: bdevsw_add failed\n");
			return;
		}
		blk_cmajor = cdevsw_add_with_bdev(-1, &blk_cdevsw, blk_bmajor);
		if (blk_cmajor < 0) {
			printf("virtio-blk: cdevsw_add failed\n");
			return;
		}
		if (devfs_make_node(makedev(blk_bmajor, 0), DEVFS_BLOCK, UID_ROOT,
		    GID_OPERATOR, 0600, "rvblk0") == NULL ||
		    devfs_make_node(makedev(blk_cmajor, 0), DEVFS_CHAR, UID_ROOT,
		    GID_OPERATOR, 0600, "rrvblk0") == NULL) {
			printf("virtio-blk: devfs_make_node failed\n");
			return;
		}
		blk_ready = true;
		printf("virtio-blk: /dev/rvblk0 in slot %d, %llu sectors of %u (%llu MB)\n",
		    slot, d->capacity, VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR,
		    d->capacity * VIRTIO_BLK_SECTOR / (1024 * 1024));
		return;
	}
	printf("virtio-blk: no block device on the bus\n");
}

```

`xnu/files/bsd/dev/redwood_virtio_input.c`:

```c
/*
 * Virtio input devices as a source of touches and buttons (see sys/redwood_input.h).
 *
 * Under QEMU's "virt" machine a "virtio-tablet-device" stands for the touch screen (the pointer
 * with its button held is a finger) and a "virtio-keyboard-device" for the phone's buttons. They
 * sit on the machine's virtio-mmio bus, which must be the current one, not "legacy"
 * (-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false). Only with boot-arg virtio_input=1: the bus address
 * is QEMU's and means nothing on the phone.
 *
 * No interrupt is used; the event queues are looked at 125 times a second.
 *
 * The keyboard is also a way to tell the kernel something from the host while the system runs:
 * F12, a process name, Enter prints where every thread of that process is (ustacks_now(); the
 * host side is "qemu/touch.py stacks NAME"). F11 is five fingers on the screen for as long as it
 * is held, which is how the way out in redwood_input.c is tried ("qemu/touch.py key fivefingers 2000").
 */
#include <kern/clock.h>
#include <kern/thread_call.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <mach/mach_types.h>
#include <mach/vm_param.h>
#include <pexpert/pexpert.h>
#include <sys/redwood_input.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>
#include <vm/vm_kern.h>

extern vm_offset_t ml_io_map(vm_offset_t phys_addr, vm_size_t size);
extern uint64_t kvtophys(vm_offset_t va);       /* pmap_paddr_t */

#define VIRTIO_BUS              0x0a000000UL    /* QEMU virt: 32 transports of 0x200 bytes */
#define VIRTIO_SLOTS            32
#define VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE        0x200

#define VIRTIO_MAGIC            0x000           /* "virt" */
#define VIRTIO_VERSION          0x004
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID        0x008
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES  0x020
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL 0x024
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL        0x030
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX    0x034
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM        0x038
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY      0x044
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY     0x050
#define VIRTIO_STATUS           0x070
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC       0x080
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER     0x090
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE     0x0a0

#define VIRTIO_ID_INPUT         18
#define STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE      1
#define STATUS_DRIVER           2
#define STATUS_DRIVER_OK        4
#define STATUS_FEATURES_OK      8

#define QUEUE_SIZE              64
#define DESC_F_WRITE            2
#define AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT    1

struct vq_desc {
	uint64_t addr;
	uint32_t len;
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t next;
};
struct vq_avail {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	uint16_t ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct vq_used {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	struct {
		uint32_t id;
		uint32_t len;
	} ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct input_event {
	uint16_t type;
	uint16_t code;
	uint32_t value;
};

/* everything the device reads and writes is in one page */
#define OFFSET_DESC             0x0000
#define OFFSET_AVAIL            0x0400
#define OFFSET_USED             0x0800
#define OFFSET_EVENTS           0x1000

/* Linux input event numbers, which is what virtio input speaks */
#define EV_SYN                  0
#define EV_KEY                  1
#define EV_ABS                  3
#define ABS_X                   0
#define ABS_Y                   1
#define ABS_RANGE               0x7fff          /* QEMU's tablet: 0..0x7fff across the screen */
#define BTN_LEFT                0x110
#define BTN_TOUCH               0x14a

struct input_device {
	vm_offset_t             regs;
	struct vq_avail *       avail;
	struct vq_used *        used;
	struct input_event *    events;
	uint16_t                seen;           /* how far the used ring has been read */
	/* the pointer */
	uint32_t                x, y;
	bool                    pressed, touching, moved;
};

#define MAX_DEVICES     4
static struct input_device devices[MAX_DEVICES];
static int device_count;
static thread_call_t poll_call;

static inline uint32_t
reg_read(struct input_device *d, uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg);
}

static inline void
reg_write(struct input_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(d->regs + reg) = value;
}

static inline void
reg_write64(struct input_device *d, uint32_t reg, uint64_t value)
{
	reg_write(d, reg, (uint32_t)value);
	reg_write(d, reg + 4, (uint32_t)(value >> 32));
}

extern void ustacks_now(const char *name);

#define KEY_ENTER               28
#define KEY_LEFTSHIFT           42
#define KEY_RIGHTSHIFT          54
#define KEY_F11                 87
#define KEY_F12                 88

/* F12 NAME Enter: the keys in between spell a process name. Returns true if the key was taken. */
static bool
command_key(uint16_t key, uint32_t value)
{
	static const char plain[] =
	    "\0\0001234567890-=\0\0qwertyuiop[]\0\0asdfghjkl;'`\0\\zxcvbnm,./\0\0\0 ";
	static char name[32];
	static unsigned length;
	static bool active, shift;

	if (key == KEY_F12) {
		if (value == 1) {
			active = true;
			length = 0;
		}
		return true;
	}
	if (!active) {
		return false;
	}
	if (key == KEY_LEFTSHIFT || key == KEY_RIGHTSHIFT) {
		shift = value != 0;
	} else if (value != 1) {
		/* a release or a repeat */
	} else if (key == KEY_ENTER) {
		active = false;
		name[length] = 0;
		if (length) {
			printf("virtio-input: stacks of \"%s\" asked for\n", name);
			ustacks_now(name);
		}
	} else if (key < sizeof(plain) - 1 && plain[key] != 0 && length < sizeof(name) - 1) {
		char c = plain[key];

		if (shift && c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') {
			c -= 'a' - 'A';
		} else if (shift && c == '-') {
			c = '_';
		}
		name[length++] = c;
	}
	return true;
}

/* Which of the phone's buttons a key stands for; 0 = none. */
static uint32_t
button_for_key(uint16_t key)
{
	switch (key) {
	case 116: /* KEY_POWER */
	case 38:  /* KEY_L */
		return REDWOOD_BUTTON_LOCK;
	case 115: /* KEY_VOLUMEUP */
	case 103: /* KEY_UP */
		return REDWOOD_BUTTON_VOLUME_UP;
	case 114: /* KEY_VOLUMEDOWN */
	case 108: /* KEY_DOWN */
		return REDWOOD_BUTTON_VOLUME_DOWN;
	case 102: /* KEY_HOME */
	case 35:  /* KEY_H */
		return REDWOOD_BUTTON_HOME;
	}
	return 0;
}

static void
input_event(struct input_device *d, const struct input_event *e)
{
	uint32_t button;

	switch (e->type) {
	case EV_ABS:
		if (e->code == ABS_X) {
			d->x = e->value * 65535 / ABS_RANGE;
			d->moved = true;
		} else if (e->code == ABS_Y) {
			d->y = e->value * 65535 / ABS_RANGE;
			d->moved = true;
		}
		break;
	case EV_KEY:
		if (e->code == BTN_LEFT || e->code == BTN_TOUCH) {
			d->pressed = e->value != 0;
		} else if (command_key(e->code, e->value)) {
			break;
		} else if (e->code == KEY_F11 && e->value < 2) {
			/* five more fingers, for as long as the key is held: the way out of redwood_input.c */
			for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
				redwood_touch_post(e->value ? REDWOOD_TOUCH_DOWN : REDWOOD_TOUCH_UP, 5 + i, 13107 + 9830 * i, 32768);
			}
		} else if ((button = button_for_key(e->code)) != 0 && e->value < 2) {   /* 2 = key repeat */
			redwood_touch_post(e->value ? REDWOOD_BUTTON_DOWN : REDWOOD_BUTTON_UP, button, 0, 0);
		}
		break;
	case EV_SYN:
		if (d->pressed && !d->touching) {
			redwood_touch_post(REDWOOD_TOUCH_DOWN, 0, d->x, d->y);
		} else if (d->pressed && d->moved) {
			redwood_touch_post(REDWOOD_TOUCH_MOVE, 0, d->x, d->y);
		} else if (!d->pressed && d->touching) {
			redwood_touch_post(REDWOOD_TOUCH_UP, 0, d->x, d->y);
		}
		d->touching = d->pressed;
		d->moved = false;
		break;
	}
}

static void
input_poll(__unused thread_call_param_t p0, __unused thread_call_param_t p1)
{
	uint64_t deadline;

	for (int i = 0; i < device_count; i++) {
		struct input_device *d = &devices[i];
		bool returned = false;

		while (d->seen != *(volatile uint16_t *)&d->used->idx) {
			uint32_t id = d->used->ring[d->seen++ % QUEUE_SIZE].id % QUEUE_SIZE;

			input_event(d, &d->events[id]);
			/* give the buffer back */
			d->avail->ring[d->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = (uint16_t)id;
			__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);         /* ISH */
			d->avail->idx++;
			returned = true;
		}
		if (returned) {
			__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
			reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, 0);
		}
	}
	clock_interval_to_deadline(8, NSEC_PER_MSEC, &deadline);
	thread_call_enter_delayed(poll_call, deadline);
}

static bool
input_attach(struct input_device *d, int slot)
{
	vm_offset_t page = 0;
	struct vq_desc *desc;
	uint64_t phys;

	if (kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &page, PAGE_SIZE, KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	phys = kvtophys(page);
	desc = (struct vq_desc *)(page + OFFSET_DESC);
	d->avail = (struct vq_avail *)(page + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	d->used = (struct vq_used *)(page + OFFSET_USED);
	d->events = (struct input_event *)(page + OFFSET_EVENTS);

	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, 0);         /* reset */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 0);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 1);        /* bit 32: VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK);
	if (!(reg_read(d, VIRTIO_STATUS) & STATUS_FEATURES_OK)) {
		printf("virtio-input: slot %d: features refused\n", slot);
		return false;
	}

	/* queue 0 brings the events: hand the device all the buffers */
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL, 0);
	if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX) < QUEUE_SIZE) {
		printf("virtio-input: slot %d: event queue of %u\n", slot, reg_read(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX));
		return false;
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < QUEUE_SIZE; i++) {
		desc[i].addr = phys + OFFSET_EVENTS + (uint64_t)i * sizeof(struct input_event);
		desc[i].len = sizeof(struct input_event);
		desc[i].flags = DESC_F_WRITE;
		d->avail->ring[i] = (uint16_t)i;
	}
	d->avail->flags = AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT;
	d->avail->idx = QUEUE_SIZE;
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM, QUEUE_SIZE);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC, phys + OFFSET_DESC);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER, phys + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	reg_write64(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE, phys + OFFSET_USED);
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY, 1);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK | STATUS_DRIVER_OK);
	reg_write(d, VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, 0);
	return true;
}

void
redwood_virtio_input_init(void)
{
	uint32_t enabled = 0;
	vm_offset_t bus;

	if (!PE_parse_boot_argn("virtio_input", &enabled, sizeof(enabled)) || !enabled) {
		return;
	}
	bus = ml_io_map(VIRTIO_BUS, VIRTIO_SLOTS * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE);
	for (int slot = 0; slot < VIRTIO_SLOTS && device_count < MAX_DEVICES; slot++) {
		struct input_device *d = &devices[device_count];

		d->regs = bus + (vm_offset_t)slot * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE;
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_MAGIC) != 0x74726976 || reg_read(d, VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID) != VIRTIO_ID_INPUT) {
			continue;
		}
		if (reg_read(d, VIRTIO_VERSION) != 2) {
			printf("virtio-input: slot %d is a legacy transport; start QEMU with -global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false\n", slot);
			continue;
		}
		if (input_attach(d, slot)) {
			printf("virtio-input: device in slot %d\n", slot);
			device_count++;
		}
	}
	if (device_count) {
		poll_call = thread_call_allocate(input_poll, NULL);
		input_poll(NULL, NULL);
	} else {
		printf("virtio-input: no input devices\n");
	}
}

```

`xnu/files/bsd/dev/redwood_virtio_net.c`:

```c
/*
 * QEMU's virtio network device as the link behind en0 (see sys/redwood_net.h for what a link is).
 *
 * "-device virtio-net-device" on the virt machine's virtio-mmio bus, which must be the current
 * one, not "legacy" (-global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false), with any "-netdev" behind it;
 * qemu/run-ios.sh does that with QEMU_NET=1. Only with boot-arg virtio_net=1: the bus address is
 * QEMU's and means nothing on the phone.
 *
 * Nothing of what the device offers is taken (no checksums or segmentation left to it, no
 * merged receive buffers): a 12-byte header nobody reads, then the frame, one buffer each.
 * No interrupt is used; the interface's thread asks (virtio_poll()).
 */
#include <kern/thread.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <mach/mach_types.h>
#include <mach/vm_param.h>
#include <net/ethernet.h>
#include <pexpert/pexpert.h>
#include <sys/kpi_mbuf.h>
#include <sys/redwood_net.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>
#include <vm/vm_kern.h>

extern vm_offset_t ml_io_map(vm_offset_t phys_addr, vm_size_t size);
extern uint64_t kvtophys(vm_offset_t va);       /* pmap_paddr_t */

#define VIRTIO_BUS              0x0a000000UL    /* QEMU virt: 32 transports of 0x200 bytes */
#define VIRTIO_SLOTS            32
#define VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE        0x200

#define VIRTIO_MAGIC            0x000           /* "virt" */
#define VIRTIO_VERSION          0x004
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID        0x008
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_FEATURES  0x010
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_FEATURES_SEL 0x014
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES  0x020
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL 0x024
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL        0x030
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX    0x034
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM        0x038
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY      0x044
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY     0x050
#define VIRTIO_STATUS           0x070
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC       0x080
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER     0x090
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE     0x0a0
#define VIRTIO_CONFIG           0x100           /* the device's own: for a network device, its address first */

#define VIRTIO_ID_NET           1
#define VIRTIO_NET_F_MAC        (1u << 5)       /* the device has an address of its own */
#define STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE      1
#define STATUS_DRIVER           2
#define STATUS_DRIVER_OK        4
#define STATUS_FEATURES_OK      8

#define QUEUE_SIZE              64              /* descriptors, and buffers, per queue */
#define QUEUE_RECEIVE           0
#define QUEUE_TRANSMIT          1
#define BUFFER_SIZE             2048            /* a buffer never crosses a page: one address will do for it */
#define DESC_F_WRITE            2
#define AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT    1

struct vq_desc {
	uint64_t addr;
	uint32_t len;
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t next;
};
struct vq_avail {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	uint16_t ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct vq_used {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	struct {
		uint32_t id;
		uint32_t len;
	} ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
/* before every frame, either way; nothing of it is used (no checksum or segmentation is left to the device) */
struct virtio_net_header {
	uint8_t flags, gso_type;
	uint16_t header_length, gso_size, checksum_start, checksum_offset, buffers;
};

/* the rings of a queue are in one page */
#define OFFSET_DESC             0x0000
#define OFFSET_AVAIL            0x0400
#define OFFSET_USED             0x0800

struct queue {
	struct vq_desc *        desc;
	struct vq_avail *       avail;
	struct vq_used *        used;
	uint8_t *               buffers;        /* QUEUE_SIZE of BUFFER_SIZE */
	uint16_t                seen;           /* how far the used ring has been read */
	uint16_t                free[QUEUE_SIZE];       /* transmit: the buffers the device does not have */
	unsigned                free_count;
};

static vm_offset_t virtio;                      /* the device's registers */
static struct queue receive_queue, transmit_queue;

static inline uint32_t
reg_read(uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(virtio + reg);
}

static inline void
reg_write(uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(virtio + reg) = value;
}

static inline void
reg_write64(uint32_t reg, uint64_t value)
{
	reg_write(reg, (uint32_t)value);
	reg_write(reg + 4, (uint32_t)(value >> 32));
}

static bool
queue_make(struct queue *q, uint32_t index, bool device_writes)
{
	vm_offset_t rings = 0, buffers = 0;

	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL, index);
	if (reg_read(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX) < QUEUE_SIZE) {
		printf("net: virtio queue %u holds only %u\n", index, reg_read(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX));
		return false;
	}
	if (kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &rings, PAGE_SIZE, KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA, VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS ||
	    kmem_alloc(kernel_map, &buffers, round_page(QUEUE_SIZE * BUFFER_SIZE), KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA,
	    VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	q->desc = (struct vq_desc *)(rings + OFFSET_DESC);
	q->avail = (struct vq_avail *)(rings + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	q->used = (struct vq_used *)(rings + OFFSET_USED);
	q->buffers = (uint8_t *)buffers;
	for (int i = 0; i < QUEUE_SIZE; i++) {
		q->desc[i].addr = kvtophys(buffers + (vm_offset_t)i * BUFFER_SIZE);
		q->desc[i].len = BUFFER_SIZE;
		q->desc[i].flags = device_writes ? DESC_F_WRITE : 0;
		if (device_writes) {
			q->avail->ring[i] = (uint16_t)i;         /* the device gets them all, to fill */
		} else {
			q->free[q->free_count++] = (uint16_t)i;
		}
	}
	q->avail->flags = AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT;
	q->avail->idx = device_writes ? QUEUE_SIZE : 0;
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM, QUEUE_SIZE);
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC, kvtophys(rings) + OFFSET_DESC);
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER, kvtophys(rings) + OFFSET_AVAIL);
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE, kvtophys(rings) + OFFSET_USED);
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);         /* ISH */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY, 1);
	return true;
}

/* A frame to send. */
static bool
virtio_transmit(mbuf_t packet, size_t length)
{
	struct queue *q = &transmit_queue;
	uint8_t *buffer;
	uint16_t id;

	/* the buffers the device has done with */
	while (q->seen != *(volatile uint16_t *)&q->used->idx) {
		q->free[q->free_count++] = (uint16_t)(q->used->ring[q->seen++ % QUEUE_SIZE].id % QUEUE_SIZE);
	}
	if (q->free_count == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	id = q->free[--q->free_count];
	buffer = q->buffers + (size_t)id * BUFFER_SIZE;
	bzero(buffer, sizeof(struct virtio_net_header));
	if (mbuf_copydata(packet, 0, length, buffer + sizeof(struct virtio_net_header)) != 0) {
		q->free[q->free_count++] = id;
		return false;
	}
	q->desc[id].len = (uint32_t)(sizeof(struct virtio_net_header) + length);
	q->avail->ring[q->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = id;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	q->avail->idx++;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, QUEUE_TRANSMIT);
	return true;
}

/* Hand up what has arrived; returns how many frames that was. */
static unsigned
virtio_poll(void)
{
	struct queue *q = &receive_queue;
	unsigned frames = 0;

	while (q->seen != *(volatile uint16_t *)&q->used->idx) {
		uint32_t id = q->used->ring[q->seen % QUEUE_SIZE].id % QUEUE_SIZE;
		uint32_t length = q->used->ring[q->seen % QUEUE_SIZE].len;

		q->seen++;
		if (length > sizeof(struct virtio_net_header) && length <= BUFFER_SIZE) {
			redwood_net_input(q->buffers + (size_t)id * BUFFER_SIZE + sizeof(struct virtio_net_header),
			    length - sizeof(struct virtio_net_header));
		}
		/* give the buffer back */
		q->avail->ring[q->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = (uint16_t)id;
		__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
		q->avail->idx++;
		frames++;
	}
	if (frames) {
		__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
		reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, QUEUE_RECEIVE);
	}
	return frames;
}

static bool
virtio_net_start(uint8_t address[ETHER_ADDR_LEN])
{
	vm_offset_t bus = ml_io_map(VIRTIO_BUS, VIRTIO_SLOTS * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE);
	uint32_t features;
	int slot;

	for (slot = 0; slot < VIRTIO_SLOTS; slot++) {
		virtio = bus + (vm_offset_t)slot * VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE;
		if (reg_read(VIRTIO_MAGIC) == 0x74726976 && reg_read(VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID) == VIRTIO_ID_NET) {
			break;
		}
	}
	if (slot == VIRTIO_SLOTS) {
		printf("net: no virtio network device (start QEMU with -device virtio-net-device)\n");
		return false;
	}
	if (reg_read(VIRTIO_VERSION) != 2) {
		printf("net: slot %d is a legacy transport; start QEMU with -global virtio-mmio.force-legacy=false\n", slot);
		return false;
	}
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, 0);            /* reset */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DEVICE_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	features = reg_read(VIRTIO_DEVICE_FEATURES);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, features & VIRTIO_NET_F_MAC);         /* and nothing else of what it offers */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 1);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 1);   /* bit 32: VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK);
	if (!(reg_read(VIRTIO_STATUS) & STATUS_FEATURES_OK)) {
		printf("net: slot %d: features refused (the device offers %#x)\n", slot, features);
		return false;
	}
	if (!queue_make(&receive_queue, QUEUE_RECEIVE, true) || !queue_make(&transmit_queue, QUEUE_TRANSMIT, false)) {
		return false;
	}
	if (features & VIRTIO_NET_F_MAC) {
		for (int i = 0; i < ETHER_ADDR_LEN; i++) {
			address[i] = *(volatile uint8_t *)(virtio + VIRTIO_CONFIG + i);
		}
	}
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK | STATUS_DRIVER_OK);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, QUEUE_RECEIVE);
	printf("net: virtio network device in slot %d (it offers features %#x)\n", slot, features);
	return true;
}

static struct redwood_net_link virtio_link = {
	.name = "QEMU's virtio network device",
	.address = { 0x02, 'r', 'e', 'd', 'w', 'd' },   /* if the device has none: one "locally administered" */
	.up = true,
	.transmit = virtio_transmit,
	.poll = virtio_poll,
};

void
redwood_virtio_net_init(void)
{
	uint32_t enabled = 0;

	if (!PE_parse_boot_argn("virtio_net", &enabled, sizeof(enabled)) || !enabled) {
		return;
	}
	if (!virtio_net_start(virtio_link.address) || !redwood_net_attach(&virtio_link)) {
		printf("net: no network interface\n");
	}
}

```

`xnu/files/bsd/dev/redwood_virtio_sound.c`:

```c
/*
 * A virtio sound device as the sink of /dev/redwood-audio (see sys/redwood_audio.h).
 *
 * Under QEMU's "virt" machine a "virtio-sound-device" plays what iOS plays: through the host's
 * sound system, or into a file ("-audiodev wav"), whichever back end QEMU is given. Like the
 * input devices (redwood_virtio_input.c) it sits on the machine's virtio-mmio bus, which must
 * be the current one, not "legacy". Only with boot-arg virtio_sound=1: the bus address is
 * QEMU's and means nothing on the phone.
 *
 * The device has four queues; two are used. Over the control queue its first output stream is
 * set to the one format of /dev/redwood-audio and started, once and for good: a started stream
 * that is given nothing plays nothing. The samples go out over the transmit queue, a hundredth
 * of a second to a buffer. The device gives a buffer back when it has played it, which is what
 * paces us: what does not fit into the buffers waits in a ring, and what does not fit into the
 * ring is lost.
 *
 * No interrupt is used; while there is sound on its way the queue is looked at 200 times a
 * second, otherwise not at all.
 *
 * The protocol: Virtual I/O Device (VIRTIO) Version 1.2, section 5.14 "Sound Device".
 */
#include <kern/clock.h>
#include <kern/locks.h>
#include <kern/thread_call.h>
#include <libkern/libkern.h>
#include <mach/mach_types.h>
#include <mach/vm_param.h>
#include <pexpert/pexpert.h>
#include <sys/redwood_audio.h>
#include <sys/systm.h>
#include <vm/vm_kern.h>

extern vm_offset_t ml_io_map(vm_offset_t phys_addr, vm_size_t size);
extern uint64_t kvtophys(vm_offset_t va);       /* pmap_paddr_t */

#define VIRTIO_BUS              0x0a000000UL    /* QEMU virt: 32 transports of 0x200 bytes */
#define VIRTIO_SLOTS            32
#define VIRTIO_SLOT_SIZE        0x200

#define VIRTIO_MAGIC            0x000           /* "virt" */
#define VIRTIO_VERSION          0x004
#define VIRTIO_DEVICE_ID        0x008
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES  0x020
#define VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL 0x024
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL        0x030
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX    0x034
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM        0x038
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY      0x044
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY     0x050
#define VIRTIO_STATUS           0x070
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC       0x080
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER     0x090
#define VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE     0x0a0
#define VIRTIO_CONFIG           0x100

#define VIRTIO_ID_SOUND         25
#define STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE      1
#define STATUS_DRIVER           2
#define STATUS_DRIVER_OK        4
#define STATUS_FEATURES_OK      8

#define QUEUE_CONTROL           0
#define QUEUE_TX                2
#define QUEUE_SIZE              64
#define DESC_F_NEXT             1
#define DESC_F_WRITE            2
#define AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT    1

struct vq_desc {
	uint64_t addr;
	uint32_t len;
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t next;
};
struct vq_avail {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	uint16_t ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};
struct vq_used {
	uint16_t flags;
	uint16_t idx;
	struct {
		uint32_t id;
		uint32_t len;
	} ring[QUEUE_SIZE];
};

/* the sound device's own messages */
#define SND_R_PCM_INFO          0x0100
#define SND_R_PCM_SET_PARAMS    0x0101
#define SND_R_PCM_PREPARE       0x0102
#define SND_R_PCM_START         0x0104
#define SND_S_OK                0x8000
#define SND_D_OUTPUT            0
#define SND_PCM_FMT_S16         5
#define SND_PCM_RATE_48000      7

struct snd_query_info {
	uint32_t code;
	uint32_t start_id, count, size;
};
#define SND_PCM_INFO_SIZE       32              /* hda_fn_nid, features, formats (64 bits), rates (64 bits), ... */
#define SND_PCM_INFO_DIRECTION  24              /* ... direction, channels_min, channels_max (a byte each) */
struct snd_pcm_hdr {
	uint32_t code;
	uint32_t stream_id;
};
struct snd_pcm_set_params {
	uint32_t code;
	uint32_t stream_id;
	uint32_t buffer_bytes, period_bytes;
	uint32_t features;
	uint8_t  channels, format, rate, padding;
};
struct snd_pcm_status {
	uint32_t status;
	uint32_t latency_bytes;
};

#define PERIOD_FRAMES           (REDWOOD_AUDIO_RATE / 100)
#define PERIOD_BYTES            (PERIOD_FRAMES * REDWOOD_AUDIO_FRAME)
#define TX_BUFFERS              (QUEUE_SIZE / 2)        /* two descriptors each: 0.32 s in the device at most */
#define RING_FRAMES             16384                   /* a power of two: 0.34 s more */
#define MAX_STREAMS             8

/* one transmit buffer: what the device reads, then what it writes */
struct tx_buffer {
	uint32_t stream_id;
	int16_t  frames[PERIOD_FRAMES * REDWOOD_AUDIO_CHANNELS];
	struct snd_pcm_status status;
};

/* what the device reads and writes: the two queues' rings in the first page, then the buffers */
#define OFFSET_DESC(q)          ((q) ? 0x2000 : 0x0000)
#define OFFSET_AVAIL(q)         ((q) ? 0x2400 : 0x0400)
#define OFFSET_USED(q)          ((q) ? 0x2800 : 0x0800)
#define OFFSET_CONTROL          0x1000                  /* a request, and at +0x800 the answer */
#define OFFSET_TX               0x4000
#define SHARED_SIZE             round_page(OFFSET_TX + TX_BUFFERS * sizeof(struct tx_buffer))

struct queue {
	struct vq_desc *        desc;
	struct vq_avail *       avail;
	struct vq_used *        used;
	uint16_t                seen;           /* how far the used ring has been read */
};

static vm_offset_t regs;
static vm_offset_t shared;
static uint64_t shared_phys;
static struct queue control, tx;
static uint32_t stream;

static LCK_GRP_DECLARE(sound_lck_grp, "redwood-virtio-sound");
static LCK_MTX_DECLARE(sound_lock, &sound_lck_grp);
static int16_t ring[RING_FRAMES * REDWOOD_AUDIO_CHANNELS];
static uint32_t ring_head, ring_tail;           /* in frames; play from head, add at tail */
static uint16_t tx_free[TX_BUFFERS];
static uint32_t tx_free_count;
static thread_call_t poll_call;
static bool poll_armed;

static inline uint32_t
reg_read(uint32_t reg)
{
	return *(volatile uint32_t *)(regs + reg);
}

static inline void
reg_write(uint32_t reg, uint32_t value)
{
	*(volatile uint32_t *)(regs + reg) = value;
}

static inline void
reg_write64(uint32_t reg, uint64_t value)
{
	reg_write(reg, (uint32_t)value);
	reg_write(reg + 4, (uint32_t)(value >> 32));
}

static bool
queue_setup(struct queue *q, uint32_t index, int which)
{
	q->desc = (struct vq_desc *)(shared + OFFSET_DESC(which));
	q->avail = (struct vq_avail *)(shared + OFFSET_AVAIL(which));
	q->used = (struct vq_used *)(shared + OFFSET_USED(which));
	q->avail->flags = AVAIL_F_NO_INTERRUPT;
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_SEL, index);
	if (reg_read(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX) < QUEUE_SIZE) {
		printf("virtio-sound: queue %u of %u\n", index, reg_read(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM_MAX));
		return false;
	}
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NUM, QUEUE_SIZE);
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DESC, shared_phys + OFFSET_DESC(which));
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DRIVER, shared_phys + OFFSET_AVAIL(which));
	reg_write64(VIRTIO_QUEUE_DEVICE, shared_phys + OFFSET_USED(which));
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);         /* ISH */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_READY, 1);
	return true;
}

/* Hand the device the descriptor chain that starts at `first`. */
static void
queue_add(struct queue *q, uint32_t index, uint16_t first)
{
	q->avail->ring[q->avail->idx % QUEUE_SIZE] = first;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	q->avail->idx++;
	__builtin_arm_dmb(0xb);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_QUEUE_NOTIFY, index);
}

/*
 * One request over the control queue; the answer begins with a status word. Only while the
 * driver starts: the answer is waited for.
 */
static bool
control_request(const void *request, uint32_t request_size, void *answer, uint32_t answer_size)
{
	uint8_t *out = (uint8_t *)(shared + OFFSET_CONTROL), *in = out + 0x800;

	memcpy(out, request, request_size);
	bzero(in, answer_size);
	control.desc[0] = (struct vq_desc){ .addr = shared_phys + OFFSET_CONTROL, .len = request_size, .flags = DESC_F_NEXT, .next = 1 };
	control.desc[1] = (struct vq_desc){ .addr = shared_phys + OFFSET_CONTROL + 0x800, .len = answer_size, .flags = DESC_F_WRITE };
	queue_add(&control, QUEUE_CONTROL, 0);
	for (int tries = 0; control.seen == *(volatile uint16_t *)&control.used->idx; tries++) {
		if (tries == 1000) {
			printf("virtio-sound: no answer to request %#x\n", *(const uint32_t *)request);
			return false;
		}
		delay_for_interval(1, NSEC_PER_MSEC);
	}
	control.seen++;
	memcpy(answer, in, answer_size);
	if (*(const uint32_t *)answer != SND_S_OK) {
		printf("virtio-sound: request %#x refused: %#x\n", *(const uint32_t *)request, *(const uint32_t *)answer);
		return false;
	}
	return true;
}

/* With sound_lock held: take back the buffers the device has played, give it what waits in the ring. */
static void
sound_pump(void)
{
	while (tx.seen != *(volatile uint16_t *)&tx.used->idx) {
		tx_free[tx_free_count++] = (uint16_t)(tx.used->ring[tx.seen++ % QUEUE_SIZE].id / 2);
	}
	while (tx_free_count != 0 && ring_tail - ring_head >= PERIOD_FRAMES) {
		uint16_t n = tx_free[--tx_free_count];
		struct tx_buffer *buffer = (struct tx_buffer *)(shared + OFFSET_TX) + n;

		buffer->stream_id = stream;
		for (uint32_t i = 0; i < PERIOD_FRAMES; i++, ring_head++) {
			buffer->frames[2 * i] = ring[2 * (ring_head % RING_FRAMES)];
			buffer->frames[2 * i + 1] = ring[2 * (ring_head % RING_FRAMES) + 1];
		}
		queue_add(&tx, QUEUE_TX, (uint16_t)(2 * n));
	}
}

static void
sound_poll(__unused thread_call_param_t p0, __unused thread_call_param_t p1)
{
	uint64_t deadline;

	lck_mtx_lock(&sound_lock);
	sound_pump();
	/* as long as the device has buffers of ours, or there is a whole one to give it */
	poll_armed = tx_free_count != TX_BUFFERS || ring_tail - ring_head >= PERIOD_FRAMES;
	if (poll_armed) {
		clock_interval_to_deadline(5, NSEC_PER_MSEC, &deadline);
		thread_call_enter_delayed(poll_call, deadline);
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&sound_lock);
}

/* The sink: see sys/redwood_audio.h. */
static uint32_t
sound_play(const int16_t *frames, uint32_t count)
{
	uint32_t room, taken;
	uint64_t deadline;

	lck_mtx_lock(&sound_lock);
	room = RING_FRAMES - (ring_tail - ring_head);
	taken = count < room ? count : room;
	for (uint32_t i = 0; i < taken; i++, ring_tail++) {
		ring[2 * (ring_tail % RING_FRAMES)] = frames[2 * i];
		ring[2 * (ring_tail % RING_FRAMES) + 1] = frames[2 * i + 1];
	}
	sound_pump();
	if (!poll_armed) {
		poll_armed = true;
		clock_interval_to_deadline(5, NSEC_PER_MSEC, &deadline);
		thread_call_enter_delayed(poll_call, deadline);
	}
	lck_mtx_unlock(&sound_lock);
	return taken;
}

static bool
sound_attach(int slot)
{
	uint8_t streams[sizeof(uint32_t) + MAX_STREAMS * SND_PCM_INFO_SIZE];     /* a status word, then the streams */
	struct snd_query_info query = { .code = SND_R_PCM_INFO, .size = SND_PCM_INFO_SIZE };
	struct snd_pcm_set_params params = { .code = SND_R_PCM_SET_PARAMS, .buffer_bytes = TX_BUFFERS * PERIOD_BYTES,
		                             .period_bytes = PERIOD_BYTES, .channels = REDWOOD_AUDIO_CHANNELS,
		                             .format = SND_PCM_FMT_S16, .rate = SND_PCM_RATE_48000 };
	struct snd_pcm_hdr command = { 0 };
	uint32_t status, count;

	if (kmem_alloc_contig(kernel_map, &shared, SHARED_SIZE, PAGE_MASK, 0, 0, KMA_KOBJECT | KMA_ZERO | KMA_DATA,
	    VM_KERN_MEMORY_IOKIT) != KERN_SUCCESS) {
		return false;
	}
	shared_phys = kvtophys(shared);

	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, 0);            /* reset */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 0);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 0);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES_SEL, 1);
	reg_write(VIRTIO_DRIVER_FEATURES, 1);   /* bit 32: VIRTIO_F_VERSION_1 */
	reg_write(VIRTIO_STATUS, STATUS_ACKNOWLEDGE | STATUS_DRIVER | STATUS_FEATURES_OK);
	if (!(reg_read(VIRTIO_STATUS) & STATUS_FEATURES_OK)) {
		printf("virtio-sound: slot %d: features refused\n", slot);
		return false;
	}
	if (!queue_setup(&control, QUEUE_CONTROL, 0) || !queue_setup(&tx, QUEUE_TX, 1)) {
		return false;
	}
	/* every transmit buffer is a chain of two descriptors that never changes */
	for (uint16_t n = 0; n < TX_BUFFERS; n++) {
		uint64_t buffer = shared_phys + OFFSET_TX + (uint64_t)n * sizeof(struct tx_buffer);
```
